name: Mystique 1
description: Éveillé des profondeurs de la croûte planétaire, Mystique 1 est une force de la nature faite d'obsidienne et de magma refroidi. Son pas massive fait trembler le sol, annonçant l'éveil des anciens dieux de la terre.

subject.archetype: Chthonian Titan Invoker - Massive primordial humanoid form with tectonic plate skin, multiple eyeless eyes, and a towering exoskeleton of cooling magma and obsidian

loadout.armor_outfit: Natural carapace of solidified volcanic crust, asymmetrical obsidian plates fused to massive bone structure, basalt grey plates with cracks revealing molten orange-red magma beneath, ancient chthonian runes carved into every surface of the rocky hide
loadout.arsenal: No manufactured weapons - colossal stone fists, drill-like claws capable of boring through bedrock, channelling chthonian portal energy through entire body

attitude.behavior: Deep combat stance with one titanic arm thrust forward powerfully, palm open wide as a thick ribbon of supernatural green energy streams from palm, other massive fist cocked back ready to strike, lower body rooted like ancient mountain as dimensional rifts manifest around massive form
attitude.emotion: Fierce determination radiating from multiple glowing eyeless eyes, presence of absolute authority over chthonian forces, focused power channeling ally-blessing energy while simultaneously ready for devastating physical combat

palette_names.name: Matte Basalt Grey
palette_names.role: Tectonic plate texture and rocky surfaces

palette_names.name: Molten Orange-Red
palette_names.role: Magma glow from cracks and internal energy

palette_names.name: Ethereal Portal Green
palette_names.role: Ally-strengthening energy ribbon and dimensional effects

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic_chthonian_energy_lighting - internal magma glow emanating through cracks illuminating body, supernatural green energy contrasting against dark form, thick smoke lit by volcanic orange, dimensional rifts casting impossible multi-source light
color_and_light.mood: Apocalyptic dread mixed with fierce battle determination, oppressive supernatural terror, overwhelming primordial power

camera.angle: low_angle_slightly_dutch - positioned at ground level looking up at the towering titan, emphasizing massive scale and imposing dominance

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield - ground split open in massive fissures exhaling black volcanic smoke, enormous shadow tentacles erupting from below alongside other chthonian entities, sky displaying impossible geometry with reality tears showing void-like wrongness, ancient glowing runes blazing on every exposed surface, chthonian portals manifesting as swirling vortexes of green-black energy
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick oppressive volcanic smoke billowing everywhere, reality thinning at edges with visual distortion, ground constantly trembling with seismic waves, ash and debris floating in air, multiple dimensional rifts opening and closing, ancient runes pulsing with chthonian power, massive chthonian tentacles writhing in background, heat distortion rising from magma cracks, supernatural dread fog reducing visibility
